metadata.scenario: A son calls for the first time asking about 24-hour live-in care for his father who has Parkinson's disease. He wants a detailed price breakdown for weekday vs weekend rates. The receptionist provides quotes for both options. He says he'll compare with other agencies. First-time caller.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Tom. I'm calling about care options for my father. Of course, Tom. What specific care services are you looking for? He has Parkinson's disease and we're considering 24-hour live-in care. I see. We can definitely assist with that. Let me get some details first. Sure, go ahead. Can you tell me about his current condition and any specific needs he has? Well, he's in early stages but requires assistance with daily activities and medication management. Thank you for that information. We provide comprehensive 24/7 live-in care. What are the rates for that? I’d like to know the weekday versus weekend pricing. The weekday rate for 24/7 live-in care is $280 to $350 per day, depending on the level of care required. And for the weekends? The weekend rate is typically a bit higher, ranging from $300 to $370 per day. Got it. So, that’s $280 to $350 during the week and $300 to $370 on weekends? Exactly, Tom. This includes personalized care and companionship. That sounds reasonable. I’ll need to compare these prices with other agencies. That’s perfectly understandable. Do you have any other questions for me? Not at the moment, but I might call back with more questions. Absolutely, feel free to reach out anytime. Can I take your number for follow-up? Yes, it's +13165552468. Great, Tom. I’ll make a note of that. Would you be interested in exploring other services, like physical therapy? I’m not sure right now. I just want to focus on live-in care for now. That’s completely fine. Your father's well-being is the priority. Thanks for understanding, Margaret. You're welcome! I’ll be here if you need any further information. Okay, I appreciate your help. I’ll give you a call back soon. Thank you, Tom. Have a great day! You too, bye! Goodbye!
